name: Moo Who
storyline: Moo Who is a multiplayer party game based on voice mimicry, in which animal players hide among the NPCs and make animal sounds into their microphones before the hunters can figure out who is faking it.
summary: Can you make animal sounds well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer party game based on sound imitation, where animal players hide among the NPCs and make animal sounds into their microphones before the hunters figure out who’s faking it.
